mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.seller_id, o.pay_amount FROM mall_order.`order` o WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.updated_at >= #{start} AND o.updated_at < #{end} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_item si WHERE si.order_id = o.order_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM refund r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id AND r.status = 'SUCCESS' AND r.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY o.seller_id, o.order_id
